text_blocks.snippet: SMR stands for small modular reactor, an advanced type of nuclear fission reactor designed to produce cleaner energy with a smaller physical footprint.

list.snippet: Size: Generates 300 megawatts of electricity (MWe) or less per unit, which is about one-third of a traditional nuclear reactor's capacity.
Modular: Built in standardized sections at factories, then transported by truck, rail, or barge for quick on-site assembly.
Scalable: Allows users to add more power units over time as local energy needs grow.
Safety: Relies heavily on passive physical systems that cool down automatically without human action or external power.
Flexibility: Fits smaller electrical grids, remote communities, or heavy industrial sites.
Clean Power: Produces reliable, low-carbon electricity and industrial heat.
